properties.notes: Proposed project involves conversion of a listed building to flats alongside new-build development within Alnwick town centre. Permission has been granted for a scheme of 8 dwellings (7 net) through conversion, in addition to some new-build development (15/02603/FUL). This is yet to commence but is forecast to be delivered within the next 5 years. The extant planning permission also includes consent for a cafe (A3) at basement level. Yield reflects the nature of the conversion, new-build development and presence of supporting uses. Also see listed building consent (15/02604/LBC).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
